title: Why AI cites your LinkedIn profile, not your company page

hero.label: of citations are people
hero.alt: 75% of LinkedIn citations in AI answers come from individual profiles, 25% from Company Pages. Source: Meltwater and LinkedIn, 9.5 million citations.

visuals.line: of cited creators have fewer than 10,000 followers; the 1,000 to 10,000 bracket alone gives 40% of citations

visuals.after_heading: The format AI engines actually cite: plain text

visuals.alt: Of LinkedIn content cited by AI, 72% is text posts, 12% articles and 11% video. Source: Meltwater and LinkedIn.
